decisions.reason: The DCDC1 load-coverage attribute still names INA219 and must reflect the accepted replacement with INA3221.

value_updates.normal_operation_role: Primary source for the ESP32-S3, INA3221, downstream 3.3V sensors, I2C display, TTP223, and AM312 when the power board is connected

decisions.reason: Changing the current-monitor device does not alter the 5V boost converter, enable control, loads, or standby policy.
The AXP2101 battery and system power path remains valid regardless of which current-monitor device is used.
Battery NTC thermal monitoring is independent of the rail current-monitor device selection.
Battery electrical protection settings and components are unaffected by replacing INA219 with INA3221.
The battery connector family, part, and pin functions are unrelated to the current-monitor replacement.
The charge-status LED interface remains unchanged by the rail current-monitor selection.
A same-message MODIFY already updates the standalone 3.3V rail load description from INA219 to INA3221, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
Addressable-LED power, standby control, and data-level shifting do not depend on the selected rail current monitor.
The interboard connector topology and power distribution remain unchanged; the historical INA219 mention does not create a current candidate attribute requiring modification.
The ESP32-S3 module selection and part number are unaffected by the current-monitor replacement.
Native USB routing, enumeration, and programming behavior are independent of the rail current-monitor device.
